userScope: Research game UI, design a natural fun vertical TikTok wheel with distinct themes and layered accessories; no image generation. User-supplied guardian/bronze/ember brand and internet imagery permitted.
artDirection: Mesin Takdir · attribute icons / bronze / obsidian
childThemePolicy: Stable visual variants from canonical wheelId and parent theme; no gameplay changes.

spin.ordinarySingleton: may animate; fixed must be explicit
spin.probabilityPolicy: Frozen positive probabilities must sum to1. Do not secretly reweight or fake sectors.

compactRosterProposal.none: Keep exact fixture None mass; reduce candidate count when needed.
compactRosterProposal.weaponTierMass: Keep each original tier mass exactly.
compactRosterProposal.powerTierMass: May change in proposed compact pool; live engine unchanged.
compactRosterProposal.timing: Any eventual production roster is frozen BEFORE outcome RNG. Never shorten a pool after draw.
compactRosterProposal.labelPolicy: Short sector aliases only; canonical name remains in readout/result.
compactRosterProposal.limits: 1–2% is an authored experiment, not an empirical readability guarantee. Long names and large None sectors need a bigger readout.

readableRoster.timing: Seeded character-conditioned pool frozen BEFORE outcome selection; committed pools cannot be curated.
readableRoster.none: Preserve canonical None except Equalizer uniform-all-live-leaves.
readableRoster.weaponTierMass: Preserve each original Weapon tier mass.
readableRoster.powerTierMass: Redistribute within the preselected readable pool.
readableRoster.catalogs: Full catalogs retained as canonical grant definitions.
readableRoster.backstory: video/backstory-roster.mjs:16 equal choices, short sector aliases and full canonical result names.

media.audio: Original procedural music, wheel ticks and result tones; no speech or external voice clips.
media.mechanismExplanations: After each result/hype phase, followed by a final bonus summary.
media.enchantPlayback: Immediately after matching Weapon Mastery and known bonuses, with the target weapon named.

sources.supports: Cohesion, audience, information when needed; theme and motion specifics are authored inference.
Readable font, contrast, simple text, redundant visual cues, avoiding flicker.
Vertical9:16,1080x1920, mobile legibility and safe zones in ad guidance; organic application is design inference.
Text contrast4.5:1; no claim about minimum wheel-sector probability.
Restraint, clarity, coherent effects; specific timings are project design.
Imported CC0 diffuse texture asset by Amal Kumar.
CC0 for downloadable texture assets; site logos/render examples excluded.

feedback.strong: Actual Tier4–5, base>=7 or strong band; card scale reveal360ms
feedback.funny: explicit funnyResult metadata; hype text and original animated reaction deliver joke
feedback.fixed: no spin, reward animation or jingle

presentation.hub: Theme/attribute vector icon; no guardian face
presentation.statAndMasteryNumbers: Internal only; show canonical level names
presentation.powerTierNumbers: Internal only; omit T1–T5 from sectors, cards and default captions
presentation.catalogIndexes: Editor only, omitted from video sectors
presentation.meaningfulNumbers: Outcome quantities, physical size, probability and explicit +1/+2 bonus explanations remain available
